newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BUX ends at a new high of 3,473.94 pts.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BUX ends at a new high of 3,473.94 pts.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mostly higher on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Friday on what traders attributed to the beneficial impact of recent privatisation and acquisition news.

"News of successful privatisation news, such as the sale of Forum Hotel (to U.S' InterContinental) and that of Royal Hotel to Israeli investors have attributed to the rise," said Adam Santha of Daiwa-MKB Rt.
Acquisition news of plastics company Pannonplast was welcomed by the market as the share extended recent gains to a new high of 4,720 forints. It ended steady at 4,700.
The BUX index closed at 3,473.94 points, up 98.33. The previous high of 3,380.53 points was reached on July 8.
But led by the pharma sector a number of other shares joined the weekend rally to new highs on the bourse.
Egis soared to 10,225 forints and closed at this level, up 565. Richter soared to 9,000 forints and ended at 8,570, up 375.
The two last first half results to be published, those of oil and gas company MOL and packaging company Cofinec had mixed impact, with Cofinec plunging and MOL remaining steady.
Cofinec plunged to a new low of 5,200 forints, although it rebounded slightly to end at 5,300, down 500.
MOL, after peaking at a daily high of 1,590 forints, ended at 1,550, down five.
